data_notes.post_race_rows: Primary plan duration ends at race week. Where provided, post-race recovery and transition weeks are included after it in the schedule.
data_notes.range_objects: Distance and weekly-volume ranges use numeric min and max fields; exact values have equal min and max.
data_notes.source_text: Each workout keeps its short source schedule entry alongside normalized workout types and distances.
data_notes.week_numbering: week counts up through the plan; weeks_to_goal counts down, with race week set to 0; weeks_after_goal identifies post-race weeks.
data_notes.weekly_volume: Weekly mileage is transcribed from the source. Race-week totals are kept as printed and may be listed separately from the event distance.

dataset.description: Structured schedules extracted from the two supplied running books. Distances and weekly totals retain the units printed in the sources; range objects use min and max.
